_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score ~32 coil (only 3% of 12h windows move ±2) plus non-negative funding means the Panic rung holds unless a flush or reclaim breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst forward HOLD-on-rung + SHORT-below-80k; narrative supplies risk-off tape confirmation but no phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays 24-31, funding non-negative, BTC fails reclaim of ~80k
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding turns negative and F&G <24 (Capitulation) or CVD/ETF flows reverse with F&G >32 (Denial)
